## What this changes

The intake receiver stays dark and unexposed — this row lands the
**prepared, verifiable machinery** for the named mutation and nothing
else:

- **`ops/src/ops/intake_operation.py` + `sig-ops intake-op plan`** — the
  single committed declaration of the dark `sig-intake` Cloud Run service:
  `sig-intake-rt`, `sig-api`'s serving digest read at apply time (never
  `:latest`), `--ingress internal`, `--no-allow-unauthenticated`, min 0 /
  max 2, port 8080, `SIG_INTAKE_ENABLED=1` + `SIG_PG_DB=sig`, the three
  secret mounts (`sig-intake-receiver-password`, `-form-secret`,
  `-abuse-secret`), and `never_env = ("SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL",)` rendered
  in the plan alongside the log exclusion, the disabled
  `sig-intake-backend`, and the backup/export infra disclosure.
- **`ops/gcp/intake-roll.sh`** — the windowed runner: `prestate`
  (AR-2 restore point: `sig-intake` describe-absent, `sig-api` serving
  digest, `_Default` exclusions) → `sa` → `secrets` (absent → QUEUED 42,
  never a partial shape) → `log-exclusions` (`_Default` exclusion
  `sig-intake-request-logs`, `log_id`-scoped to the Cloud Run requests
  stream alone — IP/user-agent platform logs out, app receipt logs kept)
  → `deploy` → `poststate` → `verify` (read-only; a missing service reads
  `UNREAD`/`not_evaluable`, never success) → `rollback` (drops the
  service + exclusion, preserves additive SA/secret declarations).
  Windows: `SIG_EXEC_EARLIEST`, the daily 03:00–06:30Z freeze, the AR-3
  batch windows (`SIG_INTAKE_NOW` test seam); `SIG_INTAKE_AUTHOR`
  required; apply queues exit 42 printing the re-run line; `--check`
  prints `PLAN:` + `check OK` with no ADC/network.
- **Two catalog-only DB-login legs** — `ops/src/ops/db_logins.py` +
  `ops/gcp/db-logins.sh` + `ops/gcp/config.sh`:
  `sig_intake_receiver_login` (member of `sig_intake_receiver`, conn
  limit 4, reads `intake.report_public`, refused writes across canonical
  ingest/claim + intake mutation paths) and `sig_intake_reviewer_login`
  (member of `sig_intake_reviewer`, conn limit 2, reads `intake.report`/
  `reporter_contact`/`receipt`/`event`, cannot mint reports or delete
  events); each queues exit 42 while its NOLOGIN group is absent; the
  `credential` leg writes generated passwords to Secret Manager only —
  never a file, never argv (HG-09).
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — `sig-intake-rt` declared with
  `roles/cloudsql.client` + secretAccessor on the three intake secrets;
  `sig-intake` → `sig-intake-rt` service binding; fixtures + tests updated
  to the declared end state.
- **Docs** — `docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md` §15 (loopback-only moderation,
  retention/purge, owner/staffing obligations, DB roles, secret handling,
  infrastructure log exclusions, backup/export disclosure) + four

- **Records** — `D-P37.59-1` in DEFERRALS (kind V, `OPEN`,

## Dark posture held

- `[intake].operational=false`, `owner=""`, `staffed=false` — unchanged;
  `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL` is never set anywhere; the deployed service
  would honestly answer `503 receiver_not_operating`.
- `ops/lb_routes.toml` keeps `paths = ["/intake", "/intake/*"]`,
  `enabled = false` — no external exposure; `sig-intake-backend` logging
  stays off.
- `D-P32.16-1` and `D-R10-PUBLISH-1` remain `OPEN`; the exposure leg is
  re-homed until announcement/public approval completes and an operator
  opens intake.
- `D-P37.59-1` records the owed re-run: every live leg
  `prepared_not_executed` under this dispatch.
